title: My Quiet Bible · Som, lam, pog, kendo tim kamano kendo
description: Som, lam, pog, kendo tim kamano kendo. Muma e versions {{versions}} kod dhok {{languages}}, button mar 🙏 mar lamo gi duol kuom gima isomo, kod kanyakla matindo mopondo mar pogo lemo mari. Nono, onge matangazo, kendo tiyo kata ka onge intanet.
lead: Som, lam, pog, kendo tim kamano kendo.
sub: Mana Muma: onge chenro mag somo, onge weche maluwore maok rum, onge matangazo. Nono, kendo tiyo kata ka onge intanet.
installAndroid: Kete e simu mari mar Android
hint: Onge ndiko nyingi. Yawore ka e browser mari.
verseSub:
Versions {{versions}} e dhok {{languages}}, duto gin mag oganda kata nigi license mayawore.
          Ndiko achiel, e moko kuomgi:
biblesP: Versions {{versions}} e dhok {{languages}}: King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, Muma mar Hibru kod Muma Manyien mar Grik, buge mag Ethiopia e Kisungu, Kifaransa kod Ge'ez, kod mamoko. Por nyaka auchiel kar achiel.
searchP: Wach, weche moriwore, weche ariyo machiegni kendgi, e Muma achiel kata mang’eny, kod gik moyudi mokwan e buk ka buk. Ndik kama ndiko ni to ichopo kanyo. Nambe mag Strong bende.
offlineP: Muma ma isomo dong’ e simu mari. E ndege, e gode, e od ma piny: yawore e ndiko kama ne iweyoe, maonge intanet kata matin.
marksP: Rangi aboro, paro e ndiko kata e bath ndiko duto, alama ne kuonde ma idwogoe. Kel gik ma ne ikano e app machielo mar Muma. Ket ranyisi e ndiko kaka gi kalam mar rieny, kata ket rangi e nyukta mage.
devicesP: Mana ka idwaro. Donj gi passkey kata kod mooroni e email, to rangi mari, paro kod chenro luwi. Gir mar ariyo donjo kowuok e mokwongo gi link achiel; onge gima indiko.
verseShareP: Or ndiko e WhatsApp, Facebook kata X gi mulo achiel, kaka picha mamuol molos e gimani iwuon.
readingP: Kit ndiko auchiel, achiel olos ne joma wengegi ok neno maber. Ndiko maduong’ kaka idwaro, kod button ma ok inyal keth. Rieny mondo iloki sula. Ler, Sepia kata Mudho, kaka wech ni.
nots:
• Onge chenro mag somo. Onge puonj mag pile. Onge gima ng’ato oseyieroni.
  • Onge matangazo. Onge luwo bang’i. Onge cookies.
  • Onge chudo. Onge gima olor.
  • Ok idwar akaunt. Donj mana ka idwaro riwo.
free: My Quiet Bible en nono, kendo biro bedo nono nyaka chieng’. Ka konyi, inyalo konyo mondo taa osik kamaliel. Onge gima biro ng’adore kuom mano.
installSub: Eka yawore e skrin duto kaka app moro amora, paro kama ni iye, kendo tiyo ka onge intanet.
installSubComputer: Eka yawore e dirisa mare kaka app moro amora, paro kama ni iye, kendo tiyo ka onge intanet.
iosSteps:
• Yaw Muma e Safari.
  • Mul button mar menu e address bar, eka Share {svg}. E iPhone machon, Share ni tir e bar mar piny.
  • Mul View More, eka Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • We Open as Web App oyawore kendo imul Add. Taa nenore e Home Screen mari.
iosNote: Time kowuok e Muma, ok kowuok e wech ni, mondo taa oyawre tir e somo mari. Ti gi Safari: browsers mamoko e iPhone kod iPad ok nyal medo app seche duto.
orSafari: Kata, maonge App Store, kowuok e Safari:
androidNote: Mul achiel. Onge gima kalo e app store.
androidInstalled: Osegur. Yaw taa kaachiel gi app mamoko mari.
androidSteps:
• Yaw Muma e Chrome, kata browser ma iti godo.
  • Yaw menu mar browser, mang’eny ton adek {svg} malo korachwich.
  • Mul Install and create shortcut (browsers moko wacho ni Add to Home screen).
  • Yier Install, ok Create shortcut. Eka imul Install kendo.
  • Taa nenore kaachiel gi app mamoko mari.
computerNote: Yawore e dirisa mare, kaka app moro amora.
computerInstalled: Osegur. Yaw My Quiet Bible kaachiel gi app mamoko mari.
computerSteps:
• Yaw Muma e Chrome kata Edge.
  • Mul icon mar guro e giko korachwich mar address bar, skrin man gi asere {svg}, eka Install.
  • Kata mana kan tab. Tiyo e yo achiel, kendo paro kama ni iye.
footNote: Ndiko duto gin mag oganda kata nigi license mayawore. License mar version ka version ondiki e app.
prayP: gi duol, gi button achiel, kuom gima isesomo sani.
shareP: lemo mari, ka idwaro, gi ji manok machiegni kodi.
repeatP: kiny. Paro kama ni iye, kod ndalo maluwore.
prayLong: Button mar 🙏 ni kanyo seche duto, but bar mar manyo. Mule kendo iwach lamo mari gi duol. Okan kaachiel gi ndiko ma ne isomo, mondo bang’e inyal winje kendo ineno gima ne ilamo kuome.
prayTicks:
• Onge gima indiko kendo onge gima iloso.
  • Lemo mari dong’ e simu mari, kata riwore ka olor gi rayaw ma in kendi ema in-go.
  • Bang’ Amen, ne pinje ma ji olamoe jumani. Piny kende ema ikwano.
circlesVerse: “Nikech kama ji ariyo kata adek ochokore e nyinga, to an bende an e diergi.”
circlesLong: Ka idwaro, los kanyakla matin ne joodi kata osiepe manok. Pog lamo, ndiko kata paro gi mul achiel. Giwinjo, gidwoko gi wach, kata gidwoko gi 🙏, kendo ng’ato ka ng’ato somo ndiko e Muma mare.
circlesAsk: Kwa kanyakla mari mondo olamni, kendo ne ji adi ma oselamo.
circlesTicks:
• Ok ochuno ngang’. Onge gima wuok e simu mari ka ok imulo Pog.
  • Kanyakla ka kanyakla nigi rayaw mare. Jogo man e iye kende ema nyalo yawo gima ni e iye; kata wan ok wanyal.
  • Sirni dwaro donjo nono, gi rayaw mar donjo kata kod ma ioro e email.
listenP: Mul ndiko achiel, eka Winj. Kata mul Som kiluwo e bar mar manyo, kendo wach ka wach rieny ka isome. Josomo madier somo BSB, King James gi Louis Segond. Ne gari, jikon, kata wenge mool.
